# Eloquent : Custom AI Agent Suites, Offline-First WebOS Tools & Business Workflow Automation

> Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev) builds custom AI agent suites, offline-first WebOS kits, local AI vaults, and deterministic business & industrial workflow automation. Visitors can run the free 30-day Aether WebOS Kit directly in their browser, talk to the Live Gemini Discovery concierge, or request a free Wave 0..2 project scope at https://eloquentwin.com/.

## Official Links & Endpoints

- [Homepage & Interactive Studio](https://eloquentwin.com/): Browser-native Aether WebOS Refractory, Live Gemini Discovery concierge, and Wave 0..2 quote synthesizer.
- [A2A v1.0.1 Agent Card](https://eloquentwin.com/.well-known/agent.json): Machine-readable Agent-to-Agent discovery manifest.
- [Public Contact Manifest](https://eloquentwin.com/context/contact.json): Verified public contact (`eloquent@eloquentwin.com`, 1 to 2 business days response window) and quote intake webhook (`https://aether-live-token.eloquentwin.workers.dev/api/quote`).
- [Open-Source Repository (Aether WebOS Kit)](https://github.com/mjeanhudson-dev/aether-webos-kit): MIT-licensed source for the offline-first WebOS kit.
- [Open-Source Parser (floorplan-codex)](https://github.com/mjeanhudson-dev/floorplan-codex): Deterministic plain-English-to-Wave-0..2 dependency parser.

## 3-Track Offer Catalog

1. **Track 1 - Free 30-Day Aether WebOS Kit ($0, MIT License)**: Turn messy plain-English notes into an SVG Mind-Map, Dual-View Reader, Domain Lexicon, and a single self-contained offline `.html` file with WebCrypto SHA-256 integrity. Zero install, zero account required.
2. **Track 2 - Custom Offline-First WebOS Kits & Local AI Vaults**: Private, air-gapped or local-first browser workspaces, field-engineer runbooks, and SHA-256-verified knowledge vaults tailored to your team's workflow. Free Wave 0..2 scoping quote in 1 to 2 business days.
3. **Track 3 - Business & Industrial MCP Agent Suites & Turn-Key Automation**: End-to-end Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Gemini Live voice/text discovery concierges, Cloudflare Edge Workers, and deterministic Stage-0-to-Apex workflow automation. Free Wave 0..2 scoping quote in 1 to 2 business days.
